panel_sources.A: Schematic: MNIST inputs at excitatory contacts of 128 trees, readout and loss, neuronal error delta_u returning as the somatic error delta_0 to every soma; eligibility x delivered credit (main.tex Eqs. factorization, dendriticlocalrule). No measured data.
panel_sources.B: Schematic: three deliveries on one generic depth-3 tree (layer scalar bus spanning a ghost neighbour, per-neuron bus sourced at the soma, exact path chain with alpha tags; Eq. pathgain). The MNIST model has two path factors. No measured data.
panel_sources.C: Actual 12 nonsomatic sites: three proximal sites and nine distal children, soma outside the basis. K1 (ones), K3 (subtree indicators, rows in subtree order), K12 (identity). K1/K3 projected rules take oracle coefficients from the exact field (badge); the per-neuron rule uses the same all-ones profile with delta_u.
panel_sources.D: Complete six-arm fresh MNIST selected-rate cohort: 10 paired seeds per architecture; 180 epochs; validation-selected checkpoint. The printed tag is the paired per-neuron minus layer-scalar contrast (shunting / additive). Decoder-only core remains fixed.
panel_sources.E: Per-neuron minus scalar (pp) in four separately trained cohorts: fresh MNIST (10 seeds), legacy DFA MNIST (15 seeds), Fashion-MNIST with the matched-width scalar fallback (10 seeds), flattened CIFAR-10 additive [3,3,3,3] (20 seeds). Cohorts are not one ladder.
panel_sources.F: Exact path minus per-neuron (pp) in the same four cohorts and rows as E; the printed note gives the fresh-cohort within-tree contrasts K3 minus projected K1 and exact minus K3 (shunting / additive).
panel_sources.G: Mean voltage-coordinate capture of D's trained exact-path fields by the K1/K3/K12 dictionaries of C; fresh cohort, trained checkpoints, 10 seeds per architecture.

numerical_scope: No fitting, selection, bootstrap, or source-outcome mutation. Existing 95% bootstrap intervals replayed exactly; seed means, paired contrast means, cohort seed counts and capture means independently recomputed as assertions.

plot_units.D: Test accuracy (%); source fractions multiplied by 100; tag in percentage points
plot_units.E: Paired per-neuron minus scalar test-accuracy differences (percentage points)
plot_units.F: Paired exact-path minus per-neuron test-accuracy differences (percentage points); note in percentage points
plot_units.G: Mean per-field capture (%); source fractions multiplied by 100
